title: Hi, I'm Ben
paragraph1: I help B2B SaaS teams get product marketing done without hiring full-time. Over the last seven years, I've worked with 70+ companies, from early-stage startups to enterprise teams.
paragraph2: My background is a bit unusual for a product marketer. I spent years in UX, design, and project management before finding my way to PMM. That's why I can own the strategy and still be the person who builds the deck, writes the copy, or ships the landing page. I'm just as comfortable in a leadership meeting as I am designing in Figma.
paragraph3: I went fractional because I do my best work when I'm solving new problems. New product, new market, new team. After doing it dozens of times, I can ramp quickly and make an impact with very little direction. Point me at a goal and I'll figure out the rest.
